title: Reject unqualified transported-projector relative population
statement: Small transported-projector weight cannot alone bound population drift by Cdelta²(r+w). Control attenuation creates an O(delta^4) floor and linked delta=p still gives diverging relative interference. This refutes the unqualified estimate,not source-CQ full throughput.

requires: Transported-effect counterexample uses actual controlled collision matrices with arbitrary coherent control/data input, not a claimed dominant reset history. Haar diagnostics keep the conditional program-average M_n baseline and support pseudoinverse.
provides: Small transported-projector weight cannot alone bound population drift by Cdelta²(r+w). Control attenuation creates an O(delta^4) floor and linked delta=p still gives diverging relative interference. This refutes the unqualified estimate,not source-CQ full throughput.
assumptions: Acceptance covers exact transported-effect obstruction and explicitly finite diagnostics only. The failed inequality does not refute stationary-target or source-CQ full-p recovery. Exact n2 half-distance(10+2sqrt3)/(27r),r>=2,and finite n2/n3 observations cannot cross support changes or imply asymptotic complexity. Shared-bank K² generic simulation versus split-error comparison is not a batching lower. Chosen-probe1/(2r) versus Choi1/(3r) is one-query guard,not asymptotic separation.
costs: Charge every fresh training program, forward/reverse simulation, rejected/early-stop branches, original noisy datum (+1 call), validation/startup, preparation, holding/memory and classical processing. Gate width/storage depend on output dimension even when sample count does not. Each datum consumes a new bank; no free batching or demonstrated practical advantage. No uncharged bank reuse, back-action,retained outcomes or future-data correlations. Monte Carlo/finite-grid/optimizer diagnostics are not received recovery gains.
